payload.summary: Search snippets use a bounded contiguous metadata and summary prefix while the complete body retains all searchable terms.
rationale: Joining summary directly to searchText across omitted payload JSON can invent underscore phrase matches. The preview therefore ends before payload JSON and does not include searchText.
Normalise before the 1024-byte cap and truncate at an ASCII separator, preserving UTF-8 and complete tokens.
Equal FTS column weights reinforce preview occurrences and change document-length normalisation; full and compact paths share the same ranking and deterministic tie-breakers.
consequences: Payload-only and searchText-only matches return a nonempty bounded fallback preview.
Disposable schema 3 rebuilds earlier FTS layouts and verifies both derived columns byte-for-byte.
Retain explicit bm25: the hidden rank column showed no material improvement with the actual joined query and tie-breakers.

searchText: search snippet bounded preview phrase underscore Unicode NFC FTS schema ranking payload
